plugin.description: Real YouTube Music: home, charts, search and infinite autoplay driven by innertube, played with mpv.

show_label.label: Show text in the bar
show_label.desc: Shows the title of the current track next to the icon.

panel_mode.label: Panel style
panel_mode.desc: Compact attached panel or large floating one.

animations.label: Animations
animations.desc: Fade and stagger when switching screens.

density.label: Density
density.desc: Row height and how many rows fit per page.

region.label: Charts region
region.desc: Two-letter country for the charts page. Empty = the region YouTube picks for your connection.

covers.label: Download covers
covers.desc: Fetches album art so rows show real thumbnails instead of placeholders.

settings.settings.layout_mode.label: Layout
settings.settings.layout_mode.desc: Automatic: the host measures the panel and the content fits it. Fixed: the plugin asks for an explicit width.

panel.panel.library.title: Your library is empty
panel.panel.library.hint: Playlists, songs, albums and artists you save will show up here.
